query: The Column of Saint Zanobi  is a monumental marble column located just north of religious building with the status of what?

pipeline_result.response: The Column of Saint Zanibio is a monumental marble column located in the center of the Roman Forum, specifically at the location of the ancient Roman temple of St. Zanibio. It was built during the reign of Emperor Trajan (98-105 AD) and is considered one of the most significant monuments to date in Rome.
